message:
Baraka, Chidi and Dalia, sunshine harvest covers the staged day load with margin.

Plainly one daily lot plus wall leak fits the panels. The need is 8.00 kWh per day in the array sizing (E16) from 3.78 kWh per day steady in the steady load simulation (E31) plus staged share of 25.0 kWh in the pull-down energy (E56), met by about 2.20 kW of panels, like half a household day so plausible.

Baraka, Chidi and Dalia, the night store carries the cooler through darkness.

Plainly the battery sleeps through the night without sun. The store is 5.12 kWh in the battery datasheet (E10) against about 4.00 kWh for a 12.0 h night hold, like a camping battery box so plausible.

Baraka, Chidi and Dalia, thin low-voltage wiring carries the new peak.

Plainly field heat plus leak divided by efficiency plus fans sets the wire size. The peak is 662 W in the peak power calculation (E60), giving 13.8 A at 48.0 V in the peak current calculation (E61), like a small microwave on a household plug so ordinary solar cable carries it.

I am not ready, because the blocking energy mismatch objection (O1) still needs Baraka to update the cooling concept and Chidi to revise the proposal to the agreed peak.
